data.summary: Beispielschutz Versicherung AG confirms it has accepted the application and issued a home contents insurance policy ("Hausratversicherung Plus") for the flat at Quellenweg 7, starting 15 January 2027, with a sum insured of €65,000 and an annual premium of €96.60.
data.explanation: This letter confirms a new home contents insurance (Hausratversicherung) policy you applied for. Coverage begins on 15 January 2027 and runs for one year, renewing automatically each year unless cancelled. Either side may end the contract at the end of an insurance year, but the cancellation must reach the other side at least three months before that date. No action is required now; just keep the policy number for reference and make sure the annual premium of €96.60 is paid when due.
